en.title: Hamburger SV Missing Seven Players Ahead of Cup Match
en.dek: Seven key players are unavailable for HSV’s DFB‑Pokal match against Frankfurt due to injuries and suspension.
facts: Fábio Vieira and Bilal Nadir are injured with muscle injuries; Nadir also has tendon involvement.
Nicolai Remberg, Nicolás Capaldo, Jordan Torunarigha and Yussuf Poulsen are unavailable.
Mario Vuskovic is suspended for the match.
Patson Daka has returned to the squad.
Trainer Merlin Polzin must reorganize the lineup for the game.
body: Hamburger SV’s squad is weakened before its DFB‑Pokal second‑round match against Eintracht Frankfurt. Fábio Vieira and Bilal Nadir are out with muscle injuries in the thigh; Nadir also has tendon involvement, according to the club’s statements.

In addition to Vieira and Nadir, Nicolai Remberg, Nicolás Capaldo, Jordan Torunarigha and Yussuf Poulsen are not available for selection. Mario Vuskovic is suspended for the match, while Patson Daka has returned to the squad.
Trainer Merlin Polzin said the team must reorganize its lineup for the game. He noted that the injuries have forced him to adjust the formation and that the club has had to improvise in recent weeks.

The club’s injury situation worsened after a 0‑1 loss to Paderborn, where Vieira was substituted after 13 minutes and Nadir left in the 71st minute. Polzin highlighted that the team struggled to maintain control and precision in the second half of that match.
en.context: The injuries and suspension have reduced HSV’s available players, forcing the coach to adjust the lineup for the upcoming cup match.
